_doc: UCG competition levels: which code values a skill and which element group it counts in. To re-value a catalog element at a level, take the first code in `value_codes` that has a record for the element (codes are listed in priority order); a skill with none of them is not creditable at that level. `eg` says how to turn that code's element group into the level's group. Sources: UCG Women's Rules v6.0 (2026-27), UCG WAG Open Scoring Level (Infinity) Rules v1.2, UCG MAG Rules Policy 2026-2028, UCG Masters Rules Policy, and the routine planner's scoring code (js/scoring/wag.js), which implements them. `planner_id` is the routine planner's level ID.
_version_doc: Date of the last change to this file; bump it whenever a level, code priority or EG map changes.

silver.name: Xcel Silver
silver.note: Xcel Silver requirements and difficulty restrictions; division-limited elements as listed in Xcel.

gold.name: Xcel Gold
gold.note: Xcel Gold requirements and difficulty restrictions.

platinum.name: Xcel Platinum
platinum.note: Xcel Platinum requirements and difficulty restrictions.

diamond.name: Xcel Diamond
diamond.note: Xcel Diamond requirements and difficulty restrictions.

sapphire.name: Xcel Sapphire
sapphire.note: No difficulty restrictions (unlimited D/E): Development Program E elements count (Women's Rules II.B.1). Vaults in the USAG Level 9/10 table but not the Xcel Sapphire table are allowed at 10.0 (II.B.2).

infinity.name: UCG Infinity (Open Scoring Level)
infinity.note: Any Development Program, Xcel Sapphire or UCG skill at its existing value; the 8 highest count; each element earns credit once. Vault uses the Open level's own vault chart (by name), not a code value.

masters.name: WAG Masters

eg.note: UCG Masters additions carry their own Masters group (I-IV).

masters.note: WG letters (and Masters ME / Misc), valued by the gymnast's age decade (Masters Rules Policy; planner masters.js).

developmental.name: UCG Developmental
developmental.note: WG + UCG MAG rules; vaults without saltos only.

advanced.name: UCG Advanced (GymACT)
advanced.note: GymACT rules; GymACT raises some handspring vault values above WG (planner ADV_VAULT).

masters.name: MAG Masters
masters.note: WG letters (and Masters ME / GE / Misc), valued by age decade.
